notes: Solved independently before reading the solution: successive nodes are λ/2 apart, so λ = 2L and v = fλ = 2fL; equating to v = √(γRT/M) and solving symbolically gives γ = 4Mf²L²/(RT), printed option 3. Every step line follows from the one above it and the algebra of the squaring step was re-derived in sympy. Both common_mistakes routes were recomputed symbolically and reach the options they name: λ = L gives γ = Mf²L²/(RT), printed option 1, and the inverted relation λ = L/2 gives γ = Mf²L²/(4RT), printed option 2. Both are genuine slips on this question and neither condemns a correct method. Printed option 4 is left unaccounted for, which the brief does not require. difficulty medium and mistake_type_hint concept are both appropriate: the arithmetic is trivial and the whole question turns on the node-to-wavelength relation.
